reader_contract.figure_question: Can a post-input successor serve as the inherited state for the next input, recur across successive transitions, and carry cumulative behavioral consequences?
reader_contract.terminal_inference: Under the tested successor-transplant intervention, the post-B Layer-2 successor is sufficient to redirect early processing of an identical next input and the post-next-input Layer-3 successor; in the independent progressive protocol, input-driven displacement relative to equal-time passive continuation persists across stages and deeper history changes behavioral rescue and loss.

transition stage is equivalent to history depth K

the progressive recurrence protocol is the same trial sequence as the transplant protocol
